description: Skill effects that CCP ships without modifierInfo (applied client/server-side by skill identity). Encoded as modifiers whose skill filter 0 means 'the skill that owns the effect' (EXCT convention). Behaviour matches Pyfa handlers droneDmgBonus, missile*DmgBonus, selfRof, cloakingTargetingDelayBonus... Bonus attributes are already multiplied by skill level via their *SkillBoost* PreMul effects.
